notes.title: New Units, Map Update & Monster Buff II
notes.notes:
Hello, bold destroyers of the Empire!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44284172/ba194cac9471d1c46d4b81b9d4f3157d78b3ff9e.png

We've updated the campaign map, adding a second bonus level (the Oasis) plus made some alternative swamp levels into new fully separate ones.

Our monster cat has received further buffs, especially to various upgrades. Melee attack hit boxes have been made a little bigger, all negative status durations have been reduced, and the visual effects of being poisoned do not alter camera view any more.

The imperial forces have been boosted by 7 new types of variety units. They have already joined imperial armies in various levels throughout the campaign, here are some details of 5 of them:

The Imperial Cook
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44284172/124237c30588b2b27427d8dee20be7d56d76c287.png

The Living Metal Axehead Rammer
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44284172/2e2f1089f02c2fce43eb59ab76164d5689114638.png

The Bear Hunter
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44284172/e0848b46e0ab8d59c5ee7f3489d6d1b1b363a4e0.png

The Golden Zweihander
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44284172/986643001ac2519720629205f3b5dfdd11b5c9c6.png

The Elder Noble
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44284172/af4f1174aed5263fe454c827ad3700717e642e93.png

Additionally, the barbarian warrior weapon was replaced with a long war billhook, about twice as long as their previous trident.

More variety units are in the works.

P.S. a bit of background lore:
The monster cat never cared the slightest about what names the humans give to their empire or any other forces of greed & domination. The cat knows the name is just another fancy label for something simply bad. That's why the Empire is consistently called "the empire" (with a noncapital e) in the game, and that's why it's specific name is never mentioned.

notes.title: Monster Cat Buff, version 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Thank you everyone who was bold enough to try the 1st version!

You're our heroes because you ventured into a hostile, unknown realm despite the well-known fact that fresh universes may come with glitches and oddities! Fortunately, no true deadly anomalies have been encountered so far...

We were worried the fine experience of crushing and slashing imperial footmen would be too easy, but turns out it was actually a little too deadly and rough - thank you for the fast feedback about this x)
Please let us kindly know in the discussion forum if you wish to propose further rebalances, the more specific (and the more kind) the better!

Today's update considerably buffed our monster cat - numerous fairly small but important boosts to attacks, stats (speed, HP, mana etc) and/or their upgrades, that together should make a considerable difference. Please make sure you have the new version 1.0.1 before playing to get all the monster buffs! 
Steam automatic game updates may sometimes behave a little stubbornly despite everyone's best intentions :') 

Additionally, pouncing/jumping now makes you properly immune to slowdown effects of the swamps.
We admit  it was like a bad dream where you're slowed down even when you're leaping through air while being chased by something unfriendly x') It's so much more enjoyable now to jump around in the puddles =^_^=

We're also creating some free extra content, more on that soon. 
The "Poisoned" status of the monster was designed to impair viewing the battlefield, but we will be changing its visual effects for greater accessibility.
We will be rebalancing and improving the game further after this update (together with new free content) as planned.

Quick tips to take with you:
1. All monster paw attacks can deflect incoming arrows (it takes a bit of practice)
2. Not moving after/while using the palm lightning spell (a high level magic) causes extra rays to appear one by one, increasing your magical attack power up to five times.
